title: Wedbush sends blunt message on Elon Musk's Tesla and Intel deal
title_zh: 韦德布什就埃隆·马斯克的特斯拉和英特尔交易发出了直言不讳的信息
summary: Elon Musk has spent years talking about vertical integration across his companies. With Terafab, he is starting to put a price tag on it. A very large one. Wall Street is now watching closely.
summary_zh: 埃隆·马斯克多年来一直在谈论他的公司之间的垂直整合。他开始为 Terafab 贴上价格标签。一个非常大的。华尔街现在正在密切关注。

title: Globalstar Amazon Deal And FCC Ruling Put Valuation In Sharp Focus
title_zh: Globalstar 亚马逊交易和 FCC 裁决使估值成为焦点
summary: Globalstar (NasdaqGS:GSAT) has entered a definitive merger agreement to be acquired by Amazon. The deal follows an FCC decision that reaffirmed Globalstar's exclusive Mobile Satellite Services rights in the Big LEO spectrum band.
summary_zh: Globalstar（纳斯达克GS：GSAT）已签订最终合并协议，将被亚马逊收购。该交易是在 FCC 做出决定之后达成的，该决定重申了 Globalstar 在 Big LEO 频段内的独家移动卫星服务权利。
